sources.title: You Yangs
sources.excerpt: The You Yangs are a series of granite ridges that rise up to 343 m (1,125 ft) above the flat and low-lying Werribee Plain in southern Victoria, Australia, approximately 5 km (3.1 mi) due west of the rural town of Little River, 55 km (34 mi) southwest of Melbourne CBD and 22 km (14 mi) north of Geelong. The main ridge runs roughly north-south for about 9 km (5 mi), with a lower extension running for about 15 km (10 mi) to the west. Much of the southern section of the range is protected in You Yangs Regional Park.
